story_world.place: a chilli-seedling nursery at the edge of a village near Haveri, Karnataka; neem tree, red-soil field, village pond
story_world.problem: Ravi must have healthy green seedlings ready for the Monday shandy in 14 days, but some are turning yellow
story_world.payoff: Ravi sells strong green seedlings at the shandy, and explains (in pictures) how leaves make food

cast.description: 12-year-old boy, short black hair, half-sleeve checked shirt, khaki shorts, rubber slippers
Ravi's grandmother, cotton saree, works the nursery

episodes.title: The Yellow Seedlings

loops.hook: Ravi lifts a flat stone in the field: the grass under it is pale yellow
A croton leaf in the courtyard is half green, half white

activity.substitute: Betadine on potato, cooked rice and a leaf

episodes.cliffhanger: The seedlings under Ajji's plastic cover are in sunlight and watered, but still weak. What is missing?
